opportunities.cgiar_eligibility_notes: Topic text: 'International organisations with headquarters in a Member State or Associated Country are exceptionally eligible for funding.' opportunities.lead_applicant_requirements: Coordinator must be an eligible legal entity; standard Horizon Europe minimum (3 independent entities from 3 different EU MS/AC, at least one from a MS) plus at least three independent legal entities established in AU member states.

opportunities.eligible_activities: Assess needs/opportunities for water, nutrient and energy management in agriculture; develop knowledge, practices and tools for on-farm resource management at the nexus; evaluate water/energy/nutrient balances, economic feasibility, climate footprint and social effects; enable circular, climate-smart and biodiversity-friendly practices for smallholders; link to AU-EU Innovation Agenda and Horizon Europe living labs in Africa.
opportunities.scientific_alignment_rationale: Climate-smart agriculture for African smallholders with tools/DSS; EO, crop modelling (water/nutrient balances) and digital advisory fit well, though topic is nexus/practice focused rather than RS/AI per se.
opportunities.strategic_relevance_rationale: Explicit AU-EU FNSSA priority, Africa smallholders, IOs funded; core CGIAR/Alliance mission and Africa hub presence.
opportunities.technical_feasibility_rationale: Alliance has Africa agronomy, soil/water, crop modelling and digital advisory capacity; energy component needs partners.
opportunities.recommendation: Top priority. One of very few 2027 Cluster 6 topics that explicitly funds IOs headquartered in the EU and targets African smallholders. Build a consortium now for the 8 Apr 2027 blind first-stage deadline.
opportunities.potential_partners: African NARS (e.g., KALRO, EIAR, CORAF members), icipe / RMRN Eastern Africa, CORAF / UCAD (RMRN Western Africa), European universities (WUR, CIRAD, Univ. of Bonn ZEF), farmer organisations, energy/irrigation SMEs.
opportunities.next_action: Contact Alliance Africa/Climate Action leads and Bioversity grants office; draft concept and identify coordinator by Dec 2026; register interest on F&T portal partner search.

opportunities.next_action: Check with Bioversity grants office whether participation could be funded via 'essential participation'; otherwise offer associated-partner role to EU contacts.

opportunities.strategic_relevance_rationale: No funding for the Alliance; useful only to support partners (e.g., Brazil CONFAP, South Africa DSTI, Tunisia).
opportunities.technical_feasibility_rationale: Feasible as an in-kind EO/data partner; very short timeline.
opportunities.recommendation: Low priority; join only if an existing partner (e.g., a Brazilian or South African group) invites the Alliance as self-funded partner before 10 Nov 2026.
opportunities.potential_partners: Brazilian state research foundations' grantees (CONFAP), South African universities (DSTI), European water institutes (Deltares, IHE Delft via NWO).
opportunities.next_action: Only act if approached; otherwise monitor the next Water4All JTC.
